events.outcome: DITO prepaid/eSIM is current and community users in 2026 report very low annual keep-alive costs, but foreign-tourist registration and the 30-day Traveler SIM lifecycle are binding provider constraints; the claimed PHP5/PHP10 annual regular-load extension was not confirmed by a current provider lifecycle table in this review.

data.acquisitionSummary: DITO currently sells prepaid and eSIM products through its official channels. Foreign nationals must register; tourists must provide passport, Philippine proof of address and a return ticket, while non-tourist foreign residents need the applicable visa/residency documents.

keep.action: 2026 community users report that a small PHP5-PHP10 regular-load top-up can preserve the number for about a year, but the reviewed current DITO provider pages do not confirm that lifecycle rule. Treat the amount/interval as community evidence only.

data.chinaActivation: A durable China-based tourist acquisition path is not established. DITO requires foreign-tourist Philippine address/return-ticket evidence; Traveler SIMs are 30-day lines unless an approved extension is completed.
data.kyc: All foreign nationals must register. DITO lists passport plus Philippine proof of address and return ticket for tourists; non-tourist foreigners need passport, Philippine address and applicable visa/residency/employment/student documents.
data.payment: DITO App/eShop and regular loading channels are current; community users report convenient payment methods, but remote foreign-user payment is not provider-guaranteed here.
data.roamingSms: 2026 community users report mainland-China roaming and incoming-SMS use with mixed device/platform outcomes. DITO does not guarantee third-party OTP delivery in the reviewed provider material.
data.holdReason: Tourist foreign-user lines are 30-day/extension-controlled and the community PHP5/PHP10 annual keep mechanic lacks current provider confirmation; mainland OTP reliability is mixed.
data.tariffSummary: Current prepaid/eSIM route with strong 2026 low-cost retention reports, but foreign-tourist eligibility and the exact annual keep mechanic remain unresolved.
guideSteps: Confirm whether the subscriber qualifies as tourist or non-tourist foreign national before purchase.
Complete DITO SIM registration with the required lawful documents.
Do not rely on the PHP5/PHP10 annual top-up claim until the current line lifecycle is confirmed in-app/provider support.
